criteria.description: One brand, four top-level entries (three links + one mega), one five-link category column, three whole-card collections, two actions, one toggle, and one chevron are authored
Exactly one ren-nav landmark and one primary links tree serve desktop and mobile

Native activation, stable desktop hover corridor, click pin, Escape with focus restoration from focused destinations, outside close, every destination class closes (category links, collection cards, CTA-style spans do not nest interactives), and mobile nested disclosure work

Desktop/tablet/mobile geometry including 320px and 340px narrow widths plus 767/768/769 seams, same-breakpoint resize stability, no root overflow, full-width desktop mega under bar, in-flow mobile mega, narrow category column beside three collections
Each collection is exactly one anchor with no nested interactive descendant and has visible focus
JavaScript-disabled mobile exposes the one tree, actions, and usable native disclosure
Visible 44px targets, single chevron/close icon, light/dark tokens, reduced motion, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
